answer: With a Documentation page passing automated tests backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The design treats each contribution as a pearl: small alone, decisive in aggregate. Whether the proof comes from a sonnet or a cipher, the verification step is identical and public.
